segments.source: Source: Told me by a yachting hand, who heard it from a Shetlander named Abernethy who was serving in the same yacht with him.
Not many years ago, some volunteers at Beaumaris swore they saw a mermaid there, and fired several shots at it.
I think this story to be genuine and beautiful.
